t: The specific heats of argon at constant pressure and constant volume are 525 J/kg and 315 J/kg, respectively. Its density at NTP will be
s:
Given:
cp = 525 J/(kg K)
cv = 315 J/(kg K)

The specific gas constant (r) is:
r = cp - cv = 525 - 315 = 210 J/(kg K)

From the ideal gas equation:
P = ρ r T  →  ρ = P / (r T)

At NTP:
P = 1.013 × 10⁵ N/m²
T = 273 K

Substitute the values:
ρ = (1.013 × 10⁵) / (210 × 273)
ρ = 101300 / 57330 ≈ 1.77 kg/m³

Thus, the density of argon at NTP is 1.77 kg/m³.

Options (B) and (D) give incorrect numerical values due to calculation errors. Option (C) gives the correct numerical value but incorrect units (g/m³ instead of kg/m³).
